items.title: What Does Walmart (WMT) Nearly Tripling 30 Minute Delivery Volume Mean?
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT) reported that sub-30-minute delivery volume nearly tripled in Q3, using its U.S. store and warehouse network. Management highlighted the expansion of new warehouse nodes that feed ultra-fast delivery from existing brick-and-mortar locations across key markets. The retailer described ultra-fast fulfillment as a core pillar of its U.S. e-commerce logistics model during the Q3 update. The surge in sub-30-minute orders is important, but investors should weigh it alongside...
